credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Eliot Porter standing next to his view camera on a tripod looking upwards taking a light meter reading. Georgia O'Keeffe stands further away sketching and looking upwards. They are surrounded by the canyon walls and an outcropping of white rocks. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Sketching and Eliot Porter with His Camera
